Load
```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
games <- read.csv("Game_Results.csv")
```


Structure
```{r structure, echo = FALSE}
spacer <- data.frame(matrix("...", nrow = 3, ncol = ncol(games)))
colnames(spacer) <- colnames(games)
rbind(head(games, 3), spacer, tail(games, 3))
```

Removed Oregon, VCU Edge case
```{r remove-forfeit, echo=FALSE}
games <- games %>% filter(!(Score1 == 1 & Score2 == 0))
```


Box-and-whisker plot, comparing winning team final scores, to their opponents (losing teams).
```{r boxplots, echo=FALSE}
games_long <- games %>%
  select(Score1, Score2) %>%
  rename(Winner = Score1, Loser = Score2) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Result", values_to = "Score")

ggplot(games_long, aes(x = Result, y = Score, fill = Result)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Winner", "Loser")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Winning vs. Losing Scores (1985 - 2025)",
       x = "",
       y = "Final Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
<p style="font-size:0.85em; color:gray; text-align:center;">Fig. 1: Distribution of Winning vs. Losing Scores (1985 - 2025)</p>




Extracting the Last Digit

```{r extract-last-digits}
games <- games %>%
  mutate(Digit1 = Score1 %% 10, Digit2 = Score2 %% 10)
```



'Invisible' frequency table
```{r frequency table}
squares <- games %>%
  count(Digit1, Digit2) %>%
  complete(Digit1 = 0:9, Digit2 = 0:9, fill = list(n = 0))
```


Heatmap

```{r heatmap, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(squares, aes(x = factor(Digit1), y = factor(Digit2), fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "#f9f9f9e3") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n, color = n > median(n)), fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "gray30"), 
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("white", "#fff7bc", "#feb24c", "#e31a1c")) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(as.character(0:9))) +
  labs(
    title = "Most Common March Madness Final Score Squares (1985 - 2025)",
    x = "Winning Team Digit",
    y = "Losing Team Digit",
    fill = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
<p style="font-size:0.85em; color:gray; text-align:left; padding-left:115px;">Fig. 2: Most Common March Madness Final Score Squares (1985 - 2025)</p>





$$E(\text{Winning Score}) = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \text{Score1}_i$$

```{r mean-score-winner, echo=FALSE}
Exp_Winner <- mean(games$Score1)
Exp_Winner
```

$$E(\text{Losing Score}) = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \text{Score2}_i$$

```{r mean-score-loser, echo=FALSE}
Exp_Loser <- mean(games$Score2)
Exp_Loser
```


$$E(\text{Margin}) = E(\text{Winning Score}) - E(\text{Losing Score})$$

```{r mean-margin, echo=FALSE}
Exp_Margin = Exp_Winner - Exp_Loser
Exp_Margin
```





```{r margin-distribution, echo=FALSE}
games <- games %>% mutate(Margin = (Score1 - Score2) %% 10)

ggplot(games, aes(x = factor(Margin))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Winning Margin Digits (1985 - 2025)",
       x = "Margin Digit (Margin mod 10)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
<p style="font-size:0.85em; color:gray; text-align:left; padding-left:175px;">Fig. 3: Distribution of Winning Margins (1985 - 2025)</p>
